items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Then, I met Claude a couple of times through the years, like he was at the Roseland Ballroom most of the time.

ctx.x: What about the Claude Hopkins Band?

Oh, Claude Hopkins was, oh, you know, Claude Hopkins was at the Apollo Theater in 1934 when Schiffman brought me to the Harlem Opera House, he was right down the Street. So, at that time, we was (inaudible). We filled the house up. We kind of let Claude Hopkins feel (inaudible) for that day cause we had the people out there.
